d:
Jharkhand News: Jairam Mahato se lekar Record Revenue tak, mantri Yogendra Prasad ka bebak intravyu
Jharkhand sarkar ke peyjal evan svachchhata tatha utpad evan mady nishedh mantri yogendr prasad ne 'prabhat khabar' ke karyalay men ek khas batchit ke dauran kaee bare khulase kie hain. is intravyu men unhonne jal jivan mishan ki chunautiyon, barka ganv men pani ki yojnaon ko dhvast karne vali kanpniyon par ekshan, utpad vibhag ke barhte rajasv aur giridih upchunav ko lekar jayram mahto (JLKM) ke davon par khulkar bat ki hai.
